sycamine.translation: n. 西克曼(<<圣经>>故事中的桑树)

sycamore.definition:
n. variably colored and sometimes variegated hard tough elastic wood of a sycamore tree
n. Eurasian maple tree with pale grey bark that peels in flakes like that of a sycamore tree; leaves with five ovate lobes yellow in autumn
n. thick-branched wide-spreading tree of Africa and adjacent southwestern Asia often buttressed with branches rising from near the ground; produces cluster of edible but inferior figs on short leafless twigs; the biblical sycamore
sycamore.translation: n. 西克莫(<<圣经>>故事中的桑树), 悬铃木

sycamores.definition:
n. variably colored and sometimes variegated hard tough elastic wood of a sycamore tree
n. any of several trees of the genus Platanus having thin pale bark that scales off in small plates and lobed leaves and ball-shaped heads of fruits
n. Eurasian maple tree with pale grey bark that peels in flakes like that of a sycamore tree; leaves with five ovate lobes yellow in autumn
sycamores.translation: n. 西克莫槭( sycamore的复数形式 ); <美>悬铃木（指树及木头）, 西克莫无花果

sycee.definition:
n. Silver, pounded into ingots of the shape of a shoe, and used
   as currency. The most common weight is about one pound troy.

sychnocarpous.definition:
a. Having the capacity of bearing several successive
   crops of fruit without perishing; as, sychnocarpous plants.
sychnocarpous.translation: a. 能多次结果的, 多年生的

sychnosphygmia.translation: [医] 心搏过速, 心动过速

sychrocyclotron.translation: 同步回旋加速器, 调频回旋加速器

sycite.definition: n. A nodule of flint, or a pebble, which resembles a fig.

sycoceryl.definition:
n. A radical, of the aromatic series, regarded as an
   essential ingredient of certain compounds found in the waxy resin of an
   Australian species of fig.

sycomore.translation: n. 西克莫,西克莫无花果(基督教《圣经》中的桑树)

syconium.definition: n the fleshy multiple fruit of the fig consisting of an enlarged hollow receptacle containing numerous fruitlets

syconus.definition:
n. A collective fleshy fruit, in which the ovaries are hidden
   within a hollow receptacle, as in the fig.

sycophancy.translation: n. 追随, 奉承, 谄媚

sycophant.definition: n. a person who tries to please someone in order to gain a personal advantage
sycophant.translation:
n. 奉承者, 谄媚者, 追随者
a. 拍马的, 奉承的

sycophantic.definition:
s attempting to win favor from influential people by flattery
s attempting to win favor by flattery
sycophantic.translation: a. 说奉承话的, 阿谀的

sycophantically.translation: adv. sycophantic（阿谀的, 拍马的）的变形

sycophantish.definition: a. Like a sycophant; obsequiously flattering.
sycophantish.translation: a. 拍马的, 阿谀奉承的, 谄媚的

sycophants.definition: n. a person who tries to please someone in order to gain a personal advantage
sycophants.translation: n. 谄媚者, 拍马屁者( sycophant的复数形式 )

sycorax.translation: 天卫十七（天王星的卫星）

sycosis.definition:
n. A pustular eruption upon the scalp, or the beared part of
   the face, whether due to ringworm, acne, or impetigo.
sycosis.translation:
n. 疮
[医] 须疮, 睑疮
